findings.text:
DSFSTG-3: 1 part to fix
DSFSTG-3[code]: In combined --resume --from-stage <s> mode, stages after <s> that are marked complete in the interrupted run's state are still dispatched covers: RQFROM-1
  Given: A previous run was interrupted; stages before <s> and stages after <s> are both marked complete; the runner is invoked with both auto-resume active and --from-stage <s>
  When: The dispatch loop reaches units after <s>
  Then: stage.start (or cycle.start) is emitted for each stage after <s>, even though those stages are marked complete in the interrupted run's state
  And: No stage after <s> is silently skipped by the resume skip guard [FIX IN DESIGN: "by the resume skip guard" names an internal code construct rather than an observable behavior; a test can only observe whether stage.start is emitted (already asserted by the Then), not which guard did or did not fire; the And adds no new testable surface and ties the assertion to an implementation name — say what someone could see happen, not how it is built]

answers: lens-correctness-design finding 1: done — The finding is correct. After the from-stage target unit is found and `skip_until_stage` is cleared (runner.sh:3653 cycle:* arm; runner.sh:3977 stage:* arm), `resume_mode` remains `true`. Every subsequent dispatch-unit iteration then satisfies `$resume_mode && [[ -z "$skip_until_stage" ]]`, causing the resume skip guard to fire for stages after `<s>`. Stages after `<s>` marked complete in the interrupted run are then silently skipped, violating RQFROM-1 ("the run starts at `<s>`").
